purpose: Teach: 晒さ/信奉/軒並み/制圧/編纂/標榜/帰化/枯渇

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の捕虜が晒された事案を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote that paper on POWs under wartime occupation, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Direct but gentle address. The cadence of a teacher who has read the work carefully and is inviting the student to own it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、特定思想の信奉者の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the ideology of the believers themselves.
lines.style: Measured, serious. Slight hesitation before answering, as if correcting a misunderstanding with care. Respectful but precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地域の商店が軒並み閉店した経済史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And that paper on the local economy — how all those shops closed down during that period.
lines.style: Thoughtful, turning inward slightly. Not a question but an opening. The tone of someone genuinely curious about how the pieces fit together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の制圧作戦を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I was looking at the suppression campaigns during that time.
lines.style: Calm, direct. No defensiveness, but a quiet firmness. Like he's clarifying without apology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古文書を編纂した学者の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you did work on that scholar who compiled the old documents.
lines.style: Observant, almost musing. A lighter touch than before — noting the pattern, not interrogating it. Teacher voice warming slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、平和を標榜する組織の活動史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I traced the history of the peace organization he was involved with.
lines.style: Even quieter now. Not evasive, but careful. Like he's aware of what the pattern might look like and is being honest anyway.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、有名人の帰化事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I noticed you also wrote about that famous person's naturalization case.
lines.style: Softer, almost gentle. The teacher is no longer listing — she's circling back. Not accusatory, but present and aware.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地下資源の枯渇問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — that was actually about resource depletion and what happens when the supply runs out.
lines.style: Quieter still, almost at a whisper. Not tired, but with the weight of someone who knows how his answer will sound. A small, honest exhale at the close.
